title: Emergency Rescue: Injured Stray Puppy Saved near Station Road
summary: We received an urgent call regarding a puppy hit by a two-wheeler near Samastipur Junction. Our team rushed to the location, provided emergency first aid, and brought him to our shelter facility.

title: Daily Mass Feeding Drive: 120+ Street Dogs Fed Across Samastipur
summary: Our morning and evening feeding teams covered Mohanpur, Kasheepur, and Magardahi Ghat. Over 120 stray dogs were served warm, nutritious meals of boiled rice, chicken broth, and pedigree.

title: Anti-Rabies Vaccination & Deworming Camp
summary: Organized a special vaccination camp in ward 12. Vaccinated 45 community dogs and distributed reflective collars to prevent night accidents on highways.

title: Happy Adoption Story: Luna Finds Her Forever Home!
summary: Luna, who was rescued with a severe leg infection two months ago, has fully healed and has been adopted by a loving family in Samastipur.
